page0.text: I should ask about those clothes she's wearing.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page0:1

page1.text:
"So, Saber, I want to ask you something."
"Yes, what is it?"
"Where did you get those clothes? You look completely different than yesterday, so you kinda caught me off guard."
Actually, I'm still bewildered.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page1:1

page2.text:
"Rin provided them for me. She thought it would be best that I avoid attracting attention, as I am unable to return to spirit form."
"I see. I had no idea."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page2:1

page3.text:
"What about them?"
"Uh, nothing... Don't worry about it."
I want to tell her they look good on her, but I manage to stop myself.
If I said something like that, I'd probably go beet red.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page3:1

page4.text:
"Shirou?"
"Uh...I...well, yeah...you know...um...yesterday's armor!
Yeah...! I was just wondering what happened to your armor!"
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page4:1

page5.text:
"There is no need to worry about that. There are no rules for wearing armor, so I have it off while I am wearing these clothes.
That armor is created from my magical energy. I can call for it as needed."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page5:1

page6.text:
...
I can only respond with amazement.
...Anyway, there's no doubt she'd draw a lot of attention going around in that armor.
But with Saber wearing something like that, I can probably make up some story to the neighbors that she's a distant relative of my old man or something.
...Well actually, I have to do that anyway.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-09:page6:1
